name: Adaptive-Scale Color Offset
definition: ACO is a training-stage module that corrects scale-dependent color mismatch in multi-scale 3DGS by applying a scale-specific RGB offset to the shared base color of each Gaussian, while keeping the Gaussian geometry and higher-order spherical harmonics (SH) coefficients unchanged.
summary: Adaptive-Scale Color Offset corrects scale-dependent color mismatch in 3D Gaussian Splatting by applying learnable, scale-specific RGB offsets to the shared base color while keeping geometry and higher-order coefficients unchanged.
